settings.heading: Thoughtfully made tools for the people who care.
settings.lede: The Support Shelf is a small library of editable resources for parents and caregivers of kids who need a little more structure. It exists because the people doing the hardest work at home deserve materials that look as thoughtful as they are.

settings.title: In the room every day
settings.text: Working inside ABA clinics alongside kids, parents and the people who care for them, not designing from a distance.

settings.title: Design is the day job
settings.text: Years of building websites and print materials means the tools look finished and friendly, not homemade.

settings.title: Made for real homes
settings.text: Every kit starts as something a parent actually asked for, then gets refined until it is easy to use on a busy morning.

settings.heading: Hi, I'm Kyle.
settings.body:
I spend my days inside ABA clinics with kids, their parents and the people who care for them. I spend the rest of my time designing websites and print materials for small businesses. For a long time those felt like two separate lives.

Then I kept noticing the same thing: parents handed photocopies, routines drawn on the back of envelopes, and good people spending their evenings in a word processor trying to make something their child would actually follow. The Support Shelf is where my two halves meet. Every kit is something a family actually asked for, built to look finished on the first day and easy to make your own.
settings.image_alt: Kyle, founder of The Support Shelf
settings.name: Kyle

settings.heading: Good materials change how a morning feels.
settings.body:
A schedule a child can read, a bedtime board that stays on the wall, a first-then card for the moment that is always hardest. None of it is complicated, but all of it takes time that parents rarely have. These kits give that time back without asking anyone to settle for something that looks thrown together.

Everything here is a format, not advice. You bring the knowledge of your own kid, and if a therapist is part of your week, the steps you practice together. The templates just make sure what you already know shows up on the page looking the way it deserves to.

settings.title: Fair value, not inflated bundles
settings.text: Prices reflect the time a kit saves you and the care that went into it. Nothing is padded with filler to justify a bigger number.

settings.title: You own what you buy
settings.text: Editable files you keep, use and reuse at home for as long as you need them. No subscriptions, no locked features.

settings.title: Made to be changed
settings.text: Every kit expects you to put your own child's name, wording and routine on it. That is the point, not a workaround.

settings.heading: The pricing principle behind every shelf.
settings.text: An equal exchange means you should feel you got at least as much as you paid, every time.

settings.heading: Rooted in something steadier than a trend.
settings.body: This work is rooted in my faith, and in the belief that the people who care for others deserve to be cared for too. You will not find that preached on these pages, but it is why the shelf exists and why it will stay honest.

settings.heading: Get new resources first.
settings.text: One short email when something new lands on the shelf. No drip sequences, no pressure.
